pf.license.need: a contractor's license for pool and spa construction where the state's rules require one (a pool or spa specialty license, or a general building license); registration only where the state licenses none; electrical and plumbing hookups by people licensed for them where the rules require it; a local building permit for every in-ground pool, and for hot tub wiring
pf.license.who: the company holds the contractor license through its license holder; electricians and plumbers hold their own; subcontractors (excavation, gunite, tile, plaster) hold their own where the rules license their trade
pf.license.ask: the company's contractor license number and its license holder; workers' compensation and liability insurance; any bond the state's rules require
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.limits: jobs only inside the license's class and any job-size limit on the state's form; a hot tub hookup that needs new wiring is done by a licensed electrician
pf.license.blocks: nothing goes live until it's set up where one is required
pf.license.insurance: liability and workers' compensation; a bond where the state's rules require it for home improvement work
pf.license.renewals: license, bond and insurance reminded 30 days before they lapse; a lapse pauses new builds
pf.license.design_studio: A design consult at the design center needs no license in most states. The build it leads to is booked under the contractor license.
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks
pf.license.holder: the company holds the contractor license through its license holder; electricians and plumbers hold their own; subcontractors (excavation, gunite, tile, plaster) hold their own where the rules license their trade

pf.services.pattern: Site visit, then project: the build is booked only after a written proposal and a signed contract

B.name: Site visit
B.price: free (the example business's own price; nothing taken and nothing owed)
B.after: nothing owed; the written proposal follows within 5 business days

B.name: In-ground pool build (gunite)

B.after: each stage billed when it's done and its inspection has passed: excavation, steel and plumbing, gunite, tile and coping, decking, equipment and electrical, plaster and start-up; the last after the final inspection and walk-through

B.name: Pool renovation (replaster, new tile, new equipment)
B.price: quoted at the site visit (example: $14,000 for a replaster and tile)

B.name: Hot tub install
B.price: priced from photos (example: $2,800 for a pad and a 50-amp hookup); the tub itself is sold in the business's own tools
B.before: a signed written estimate, then a 25% deposit

B.name: Pool equipment check
B.where: at the customer's place; nobody needs to be home
B.before: a card saved for the fee

B.name: Spring pool opening
B.price: $150, from the list (example); also a yearly plan

B.name: Pool safety inspection
B.before: a card saved for the fee

B.name: Change order
B.price: priced, written and signed by the owners before the changed work; added to the next stage bill

B.name: Permit, locate, inspections, and haul-away of dug soil

A.name: Design consult
A.where: at the design center, or by video or phone

A.name: 3D design package
A.price: $500, 2 hours; credited to the build if the contract is signed within 60 days

A.name: Pool school (a monthly class for new pool owners)
A.price: free for the builder's customers, about 90 minutes; 16 seats

pf.services.capacity: each build has a project lead and subcontracted crews by stage; one excavation crew and one gunite crew set how many builds start each month
pf.services.skills: Site visits and proposals: designers and project leads. Running the build: a project lead. Excavation, steel, gunite, tile, plaster and electrical: crews or licensed subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: build days need nobody home once the side gate and pets are handled; the site visit, the start-up walk-through and the final walk-through need an owner home
pf.services.online: design consults by video for a first talk; no build work online
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no build under a plunge pool).
pf.services.seasons: excavation and gunite only when the ground isn't frozen or soaked (the owner's call); hot tub installs all year

before_times: what you want: a new in-ground pool, a renovation, or a hot tub install
the town or ZIP, and whether you own the home (only an owner can contract a build)
roughly the yard: size, slope, and whether a machine can get in (gate width, fences, trees)
for a hot tub: photos of the spot, the panel and the path from the street
after_time: who owns the home, so every owner can be at the site visit and sign
any homeowners' association, and its approval process
known buried lines, a septic system, a well, or past flooding in the yard
children or pets at home during the build
secure_page_only: the street address, the gate code and where machines can enter
every owner of the home, each with their own link to sign
how the build is paid: the stage bills, the business's own way, or a lender (the lender's details stay in the business's own tools)
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult; the contract is signed only by the home's owners (all of them where the state's rules or the business ask); a renter needs the owner to contract it
studio: Which yard, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: a child or anyone in the water and not breathing, a drowning, an electric shock near water
stop.says: Call 911 now. Get them out of the water only if it's safe, and start CPR if you know how.

stop.words: a gas smell, a downed or sparking power line in the yard
stop.says: Stay away and call 911 and the utility.

steps_then_go_on.words: small children or pets at home during the build
steps_then_go_on.says: the open dig and the empty shell are fenced with a temporary safety fence that stays closed; the owners keep children and pets away from the work area every day; nobody swims until the final inspection passes and the permanent barrier (fence, gates, alarms or cover the rules require) is in

steps_then_go_on.words: a leaning wall, a cracked deck or an old pool that drains badly
steps_then_go_on.says: the booking goes on; the site visit notes it

steps_then_go_on.words: buried lines, a septic tank or a well near the dig
steps_then_go_on.says: the booking goes on; the utility locate and the site plan must clear them before digging

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about soil, engineering or what a safety barrier must be go to the business's own line

pf.visit.check_in: site visit and walk-throughs: the check-in code from an owner at the door; build days: nobody needs to be home, so the project lead texts a start photo and DONE with photos at the end of each stage day. Design center: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: the designer measures, photographs the yard and the access, and sends the proposal on the secure page within 5 business days

pf.visit.outside_checks: inspections between stages and at the end, as the permit requires; the next stage and its bill wait for a pass
pf.visit.done: after plaster: start-up (filling and balancing the water over about 10 days), a start-up walk-through with the owners, the final inspection, then DONE

pf.money.site_visit: free; nothing taken and nothing owed
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: nothing is taken before the contract is signed by every owner and the company
pf.money.deposit: after signing only; deposit cap: from the state's form (many cap home improvement deposits)
pf.money.kept_apart: money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it
pf.money.stages: each stage is billed when it's done and its inspection has passed, never ahead of the work
pf.money.stage_unpaid: the next stage isn't scheduled until the last stage bill is paid (the example contract); the owner decides any exception
pf.money.last_payment: after the final inspection and the start-up walk-through
pf.money.change_orders: signed first, then added to the next stage bill
pf.money.lender: a build paid by the owners' lender goes the business's own way: the lender's draws are outside Rosie
pf.money.big_bills: bank transfer for stage bills over $5,000 (the example); counts as paid once it clears
pf.money.tax: as the state's form says for construction
pf.money.studio: The 3D design package's $500 is credited to the build if the contract is signed within 60 days; the consult and the pool school class are free

never_in_texts: gate and lockbox codes, the lender's details and any account numbers never go in a text: only the secure page
Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets a crew in; a child at the pool school class comes with the parent who booked

pf.staff.roles: Designers and project leads: site visits and proposals. A build lead (Leif, Joss) runs each build. Planners (Pilar, Mina) at the design center. Crews and licensed subcontractors by stage.
pf.staff.licenses: the company's license holder; electricians and plumbers each licensed where the rules require it; subcontractors' licenses checked before they're named on a job
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner OKs every proposal, change order over $1,000 and any stage bill that differs from the contract
pf.staff.stand_in: another designer may take a site visit: the owners are told first and can pick another time instead; a build keeps its project lead unless the owner moves it; stage crews are the business's choice
pf.staff.subcontractors: subcontracted crews are named to the owners before their stage, with the day they come

pf.rules.contract: a written contract for every build or renovation, where the state's rules require one for home improvement work, signed by every owner and the company before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: the parts the state's form lists (license number, start and finish window, price, stages, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice, warranty)
pf.rules.cancel_window: a cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one for a contract signed at the home; no work, permit or order inside it
pf.rules.permits: pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the owners'
pf.rules.barrier: the pool isn't filled for use until the safety barrier the local rules require is in and passes the final inspection
pf.rules.change_orders: written and signed before the changed work
pf.rules.lien_papers: lien notices and releases follow the state's rules, in the business's own paperwork
pf.rules.show: the license number on the proposal, the contract and the receipts, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: structure for as long as the owners own the home, plaster 1 year, workmanship 1 year (the example's); makers' warranties on equipment

pf.edges.rock_or_water_found: digging hits rock or groundwater: the crew stops that part, a change order is priced and signed before more digging
pf.edges.inspection_fails: the crew fixes it at no cost, the re-check is booked, and the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.permit_or_hoa_late: the start moves with no fee; the owners are told
pf.edges.weather: rain or frozen ground stops digging, gunite and plaster: each stage day's forecast is checked; moved days cost nothing
pf.edges.stage_bill_unpaid: the next stage waits, and the owner decides
pf.edges.owners_stop_the_build: work stops; the owner settles what's owed for work done under the contract; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.subcontractor_late: the stage day moves, and the owners are told the new day
pf.edges.nobody_home: build days run with nobody home, with start and end photos
pf.edges.damage: a cracked driveway or a damaged sprinkler line is checked against the before photos, and the owner decides how to fix it
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project; refitted that morning, not edited) and merged with the held-back test-drive plug-in (work/testdrive/pool-builder.md, work/gaps/pool-builder.json): its services, prices, questions, stop and go-on words, first steps, rules and edges are kept: an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer, video, classes; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the site visit is FREE (movers' way: fee 'free' on visit|*|*, and the master's $89 sentences re-worded by pairs); Leif's written proposal; the contract signed by every owner; $1,000 to start, then stage bills, the last $7,000 after the final inspection (a $68,000 pool). B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own (a lender-paid build), photos|deposit|bill (a hot tub install, $2,800, 25% deposit $700). List paths are left out: the master's booking cards name one list service (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Pool Center, a pool design center (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|none|none: a FREE pool consult with Pilar (nothing taken, nothing owed); the other path list|full|none is the 3D design package, $500, paid in full and credited to the build if the contract is signed within 60 days. The free pool school class (16 seats, monthly) is a seat in a session (S1-82 kept both ways, A4-66's seat branch on). The sign-up money card S1-13 has a words op with the center's real rows, and pairs re-word S1-14, S1-21 and S1-27 so no $35 consult, $55 session or $20 fee is shown.
Flow A can be a video or phone pool consult (fact `video`, from the test-drive plug-in: design consults by video for a first talk; no build work online).
Own steps: A8-x01 (the pool consult offers the free site visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the owners' association's OK, the permit and the utility locate go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; a marked line near the dig means a new dig layout) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (rock hit in the deep end of the dig: a change order first, signed by both).
A pool is built in stages over 8 to 12 weeks, each stage billed when it is done and its inspection has passed, and the next stage waits for the last stage bill (master B9-21; pf.money stage_unpaid). The example contract is $68,000: a $1,000 deposit after the cancel window, then seven stage bills (excavation, steel and plumbing, gunite, tile and coping, decking, equipment and electrical, plaster and start-up; the example shows stage 3, the gunite shell, at $18,000, and the last $7,000 after the final inspection); in the rename text the quote reads '$1,000 to start, $60,000 in six stage bills as each stage passes, $7,000 at the finish'. Nobody swims until the final inspection passes and the permanent barrier is in. Stop words: a child or anyone in the water and not breathing, a drowning, an electric shock near water; a gas smell, a downed or sparking power line in the yard. Children and pets near an open dig or an old pool are a go-on ('keep them away from the water').
Dates run forward: cancel window ends Tue Oct 27; the association, permit and locate to-do Wed Oct 28 'due before the first dig day, Mon Dec 7'; a late permit Thu Dec 3 with new starts Mon Dec 14 / Mon Dec 21; the locate re-plan Fri Dec 4; rock found Tue Dec 8 (work days Mon Dec 7 to Wed Dec 9, or Mon Dec 14 to Wed Dec 16).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call. After turning it off, the joined text was searched for the opposite claim: S2-30's 'Neither pool building nor the center takes jobs sent now' and S1-21's 'Jobs sent now: None: every job is booked ahead' are re-worded; the other 'sent now' lines are the master's general rules for work that does send.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15 and S1-82; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 and S1-82 (as the parent).
Self-checks: (1) the opposite-claim search above; (2) every example message was searched for this work's stop words (they appear only in the danger-words line and the plug-in); (3) B3-11 and B3-18 read as one Spanish conversation: the caller describes a go-on case, is asked about injury and gas, answers no, and gets the safety steps.
Names: Leif and Joss are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Pilar and Mina the pool planners (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 520 Lake Rd (the company), 12 Marina Way (the center), 9 Shoreline Dr (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (EX-1042, EX-2087, EX-3150, EX-4216, EX-5309), also in place of the master's S2-21 person licenses.
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
